in_marathi.name: Chakrika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Turning the wheel of dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chakrika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chakrika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chakra' meaning wheel and 'rika' meaning turning. This name signifies the turning of the wheel of dharma and is associated with the goddess Durga, who rides a chariot with eight wheels.
